method: Run current V10/V11 source and the pinned FakeDisplay, inject one failure before XTest KeyRelease and one failure after FakeDisplay applies KeyRelease but before XSync returns, then observe caller receipts, owner-held state, keymap state, retry requests, syncs, and cleanup.
decision: A failed call must not fabricate an applied-release receipt. A successful retry receipt is interpreted according to the frozen fields: request+sync completion only, unless independent pre/post key-state evidence proves an edge.
scope: Synthetic FakeDisplay construction only; no live X server, OS input, game, model, or allocation. The post-XSync-failure injection models a server-processed release with an exception at the client synchronization boundary.
